claim_ceiling: center_projected validated as default reference (LangDom=0.763, JP=0.528, 7→100, 74% imp, HA=0.058); THREE new valid representations pass both adversarial gates with meaningful structure: (1) hybrid_stabilized_epoch1: LangDom=0.660, JP=0.682, 7→107 — stabilized via loss scheduling + diversified pairs + hierarchy backprop (6 valid epochs); (2) linear_metric_epoch4: LangDom=0.673, JP=0.707, 5→82 — HIGHEST JP ever, simplest (~98K params), 18+ valid epochs; (3) mahalanobis_metric_epoch4: LangDom=0.678, JP=0.689, 7→112 — best legal_area NMI=0.603, 18+ valid epochs. All superior to center_projected on jurist usability. contrastive_projection and signal_outcome_tfidf pass adversarial but overcluster (1→1000) — false positive artifacts. All signal ablation hybrids FAIL adversarial gates. Pre-trained legal embeddings FAIL completely. Citation role pipeline fixed but sparse (4.5%); deferred to 192k. Jurist framework ready, not executed. GPU fine-tuning BLOCKED; CPU alternatives SUCCEED and EXCEED targets.
